title: Preserve winding transport while enforcing exact no-slip support
statement: The source lifts exact graph currents Dq=0 through RT fields and compact box smoothing into H1 divergence-free no-slip velocities, preserving their mean and winding flows. Exact spline energies give L=(h^2/M^3)J G^-1 J^T. Dyadic rounding plus tree correction restores exact conservation; poor trial currents weaken the lower rather than invalidate it.

requires: Supplied periodic image-defined pore domain with nonempty solid and declared voxel scale
Exact conservative trial currents, compact support buffer, positive trial Gram and equilibrated row-wise original-domain stresses
Physical transfer separately requires warranted inner AND outer pore inclusions, wall/flow law, viscosity and periodic/RVE admission
provides: A continuous all-force Stokes tensor lower from any admitted finite trial currents
assumptions: A curl-only periodic potential would erase mean transport
Erosion can destroy narrow connections; no universal captured fraction
A physical geometry buffer needs an inclusion warranty, not only Hausdorff closeness
costs: Source reports 123.953246 seconds of completed lower/upper producer and consumer computation, excluding source/network, startup, proof and review
Exact integer repair, rational energy, 3x3 tensor tests, all failed solves and geometry buffer; peak memory unmeasured
contract.units: K in voxel-squared units, scaled by h^2 at the declared h=5.345 micrometres; <u>=K f/mu. Gradient energy and total-cell volume, not an unqualified Darcy measurement.
contract.obstruction: Discrete conservation or a visually plausible image flow does not itself give a conforming continuous lower.

body: The segmented image is not a warranted physical inner or outer pore inclusion, representative volume or measured rock permeability. All three upper MINRES solves hit their 800-iteration cap; exact equilibrium/energy checks, not convergence, support the bound. The scalar initializer is not a matched strong Stokes/FEM/FFT benchmark. The broad bracket is not high-accuracy continuum estimation, a generic convergence rate or practical advantage. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Acquired completed whole proof/code and actual-receipt root reviews at the same original periodic-image continuum scope. Pending producer headers/older receipts are historical. No numerical replay or new scientific audit is performed.
